headerDisplay: Controls Casper Glow lights over Bluetooth LE through BlueZ (Linux). Leave the device list empty and restart once to log the MAC addresses of nearby lights (they advertise as "Jar…").

adapter.title: Bluetooth Adapter
adapter.description: Optional. Defaults to the first adapter BlueZ reports.

scanOnStartup.title: Scan on startup
scanOnStartup.description: Log nearby Casper Glow lights for 30 seconds after startup (always done when no lights are configured).

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the light's state (on/off, battery). 0 disables polling; minimum 15.

dimmingTime.title: Dimming time (minutes)
dimmingTime.description: Sent with brightness changes until the light reports its own dimming time.
